title: TPS Checker
description: Simple TPS Checker for 1.7.10. Server Side Only
body:
This mod adds a simple /tps command for Forge 1.7.10 servers, allowing players to check the server's ticks per second (TPS) in real time. Server owners can configure whether the command is admin-only or accessible to all players through a config setting.

Designed to be lightweight and efficient, this mod provides an easy way to monitor server performance without requiring large monitoring plugins or external tools. Ideal for private servers, modded communities, or anyone who wants a quick way to check server stability.


**Only required on the server.**
